forum.title: STM32G0B1RE + CAN-FD 4 (NCV7344) - CAN FD frames not reaching receiver Raspberry Pi (MCP2517FD)
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello,

CAN issues implies many aspects when you are in Normal mode: hardware and software.

So again you need to share your schematics I cannot follow your hardware configuration by text.

1- You are using HSI as clock source for FDCAN which is not recommended:

![mALLEm_0-1778681987018.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/a128421b-eb40-3b8e-ec49-7dacd824a534.png "mALLEm_0-1778681987018.png")

![mALLEm_1-1778682006273.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/3bbfb47f-128e-bd68-23b6-fb0d4a6978b7.png "mALLEm_1-1778682006273.png")

Please use STLINK MCO as clock source for the MCU (HSE in Bypass mode) with frequency input set at 8MHz:

![mALLEm_2-1778682227958.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/1a08dcaf-41cc-8128-52fd-35fc712e35c2.png "mALLEm_2-1778682227958.png")

2- Why are you setting FDCAN clock (64MHz) > System clock (32MHz)?

![mALLEm_3-1778682553060.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/8b3abaff-dab7-b59d-c783-9f9748d26e23.png "mALLEm_3-1778682553060.png")

![mALLEm_4-1778682566009.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/c386a7da-e67e-7a2e-4404-715614f2a14d.png "mALLEm_4-1778682566009.png")

The FDCAN requires that the CAN time quanta clock is always below the APB clock. Please read this article: FAQ: [Fixing STM32 FDCAN communication disruptions - APB bus, kernel, and time quanta clocks](https://community.st.com/t5/stm32-mcus/faq-fixing-stm32-fdcan-communication-disruptions-apb-bus-kernel/ta-p/730298)

3- I don't see the call of **HAL\_FDCAN\_Start()** !!

4- The bit time configuration seems to be correct but why doing this for the compensation ?

```

/* Enable Transmitter Delay Compensation for CAN-FD.

* Auto mode is default on STM32G0 when TDC is enabled.*/

hfdcan1.Instance->DBTP |= FDCAN_DBTP_TDC;

```

Please use this code:

```

/**

* Configure and enable Tx Delay Compensation, required for BRS mode.

* TdcOffset default recommended value: DataTimeSeg1 * DataPrescaler

* TdcFilter default recommended value: 0

*/

if (HAL_FDCAN_ConfigTxDelayCompensation(&hfdcan1, (hfdcan1.Init.DataPrescaler * hfdcan1.Init.DataTimeSeg1), 0U) != HAL_OK)

{

Error_Handler();

}

if (HAL_FDCAN_EnableTxDelayCompensation(&hfdcan1) != HAL_OK)

{

Error_Handler();

}

```

I invite you to refer to this knowledge base article: [STM32 FDCAN running at 8 Mb/s on NUCLEO boards](https://community.st.com/t5/stm32-mcus/stm32-fdcan-running-at-8-mb-s-on-nucleo-boards/ta-p/730281)

NUCLEO-G0B1RE board was already used:

![mALLEm_5-1778683155816.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/2f0aae32-9e98-3391-08f6-3b6a716c10c7.png "mALLEm_5-1778683155816.png")

The project is in this [Github hotspot](https://github.com/stm32-hotspot/CKB-STM32-FDCAN-8Mbs).

Hope that helps.
forum.author: Azizzr02

scraped_replies.html:
Hello,

You need to provide more details.

Your complete STM32G0 project including the ioc file. to check all the parameters.

Your schematics including the transceiver+ the terminating resistors on the CAN bus.

What is the target bitrates in FDCAN mode: nominal and data phase?

As we don't support Raspberry Pi, you need to ensure you set correctly the FDCAN parameters from that side (timings, mode etc) ..

scraped_replies.html:
Hello,

CAN issues implies many aspects when you are in Normal mode: hardware and software.

So again you need to share your schematics I cannot follow your hardware configuration by text.

1- You are using HSI as clock source for FDCAN which is not recommended:

Please use STLINK MCO as clock source for the MCU (HSE in Bypass mode) with frequency input set at 8MHz:

2- Why are you setting FDCAN clock (64MHz) > System clock (32MHz)?

The FDCAN requires that the CAN time quanta clock is always below the APB clock. Please read this article: FAQ: Fixing STM32 FDCAN communication disruptions - APB bus, kernel, and time quanta clocks

3- I don't see the call of HAL_FDCAN_Start() !!

4- The bit time configuration seems to be correct but why doing this for the compensation ?

 /* Enable Transmitter Delay Compensation for CAN-FD.
 * Auto mode is default on STM32G0 when TDC is enabled.*/
 
 hfdcan1.Instance->DBTP |= FDCAN_DBTP_TDC;

Please use this code:

 /**
 * Configure and enable Tx Delay Compensation, required for BRS mode.
 * TdcOffset default recommended value: DataTimeSeg1 * DataPrescaler
 * TdcFilter default recommended value: 0
 */
 if (HAL_FDCAN_ConfigTxDelayCompensation(&hfdcan1, (hfdcan1.Init.DataPrescaler * hfdcan1.Init.DataTimeSeg1), 0U) != HAL_OK)
 {
 Error_Handler();
 }

 if (HAL_FDCAN_EnableTxDelayCompensation(&hfdcan1) != HAL_OK)
 {
 Error_Handler();
 }

I invite you to refer to this knowledge base article: STM32 FDCAN running at 8 Mb/s on NUCLEO boards

 NUCLEO-G0B1RE board was already used:

The project is in this Github hotspot.

Hope that helps.
